summary: Iteration 81 — Wishlist × Dealer regression on Cornwell Tools (via MechanicLTZ@gmail.com Pro account). Backend + frontend both PASS. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_wishlist_dealer_filter.py — POST /api/wishlist with dealer_id auto-fills dealer_name (verified against a freshly created dealer), GET /api/wishlist?dealer_id=<id> returns ONLY items for that dealer (cross-dealer leak test), unfiltered GET returns the created items, and a bogus dealer_id returns []. Frontend: (1) Vault > Wishlist card layout confirmed — DOM traversal of a card shows text lines in the requested order: Name → HIGH (priority pill) → 3-dot icon → Model: <n> → Dealer name + $Cost → CONVERT + PURCHASED buttons (URL + Notes rows appear only when present, as designed). testIDs wish-menu-<id>, wish-convert-<id>, wish-bought-<id> all present. (2) Dealer detail 4th tab 'WISHLIST (n)' visible alongside COMPANY/AGENTS/ACCOUNTS; tapping it does NOT crash (red-screen regression from missing AppImage import is FIXED — confirmed by inspecting /app/frontend/app/dealer/[id].tsx line 22 has `import { AppImage } from '../../src/components/AppImage'`). dealer-wishlist-box + dealer-wish-add + dealer-wish-<id> rows all render. (3) Tapping ADD WISHLIST ITEM opens a modal titled 'NEW WISHLIST ITEM' with 'Dealer: Cornwell Tools' auto-shown in orange, an ADD PHOTO tile, Name/Model #/Cost/Website inputs, LOW/NORMAL/HIGH priority selector (NORMAL default), Notes textarea, plus CANCEL + ADD buttons — matches spec exactly (screenshot iter81_modal_open.png). (4) Entering a name and pressing ADD closes the modal; the new item lands in both /api/wishlist?dealer_id=<id> (3 matches) AND unfiltered /api/wishlist (3 matches) with dealer_name='Cornwell Tools' and dealer_id auto-filled by the backend. No red-screen, no PAGEERR fired in either dealer nav or wishlist nav. Note: RN Web Touchable/Pressable required PointerEvent dispatch (pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click) rather than plain .click() to reliably trigger onPress on this preview — that's a test-harness artifact only, not a real-user issue on touch devices. Note: the 3-dot wish-menu-<id> button fires an Alert.alert with Share/Edit/Delete/Cancel, which on RN Web renders as a full-screen dark overlay; the button DOES fire (overlay visible) but text-based probes can't see the buttons because the overlay's inner text isn't in body.innerText at capture time — pre-existing RN Web Alert behavior across the app, not a regression.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/dealer/[id].tsx is 2356 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting the four tab panels (COMPANY / AGENTS / ACCOUNTS / WISHLIST), the two modals (EDIT DEALER, NEW WISHLIST ITEM), and the BalanceSection into their own files. Same feedback carried from prior iterations.
/app/frontend/app/wishlist.tsx is 1138 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Extract the wish add/edit modal, the item card, and the itemMenu / bulk-select logic into smaller modules.
routes_wishlist.py::list_wishlist correctly narrows on dealer_id when provided and preserves the original purchased filter — clean, no ObjectId leak (projection excludes _id). No changes needed.
routes_wishlist.py::create_wishlist auto-fills dealer_name via a single DB lookup when the client provides dealer_id but omits dealer_name — verified end-to-end. Good defensive pattern.

Dealer wishlist tab uses <AppImage> for photo thumbs (line 828) — the missing import that caused the red-screen crash is now correctly declared at line 22. Consider adding a lint rule (e.g. eslint no-undef with the AppImage global banned) so this specific class of crash is caught at build time next time.
seed_data_creation: Test class creates two throwaway dealers (TEST_wishdealer_A_* / _B_*) and 2 wishlist items during the pytest run, cleaned up in module-scoped fixture teardown. Frontend flow created 1 additional TEST_ wishlist item on Cornwell Tools and cleaned up afterwards (fetched /api/wishlist and DELETE'd every item whose name starts with 'TEST_').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth on this preview: POST /api/auth/login {email,password} then localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.token', token) + localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.user', JSON.stringify(user)). MechanicLTZ@gmail.com / Blue321! is the Pro account (no free-tier tool cap). Dealer detail 4th tab is 'wishlist' — activeTab state accepts 'company'|'agents'|'accounts'|'wishlist'. testIDs: dealer-wishlist-box, dealer-wish-add, dealer-wish-<id>. Add modal has NO testID on its title/inputs beyond the placeholder — inputs are matched via placeholder='Name'|'Model #'|'Cost ($)'|'Website (optional)' and priority buttons by their LOW/NORMAL/HIGH text. Save button is a bare TouchableOpacity with text 'ADD' (no testID). Consider adding testIDs (e.g. dealer-wish-modal-name, dealer-wish-modal-save) if this modal will be re-tested frequently. Vault wishlist card testIDs: wish-card-<id>, wish-menu-<id>, wish-convert-<id>, wish-bought-<id>, wish-restore-<id>, wish-open-<id>, wish-tool-link-<id>. RN Web Alert.alert renders as full-screen black overlay on this preview — the buttons ARE tappable but their text isn't in body.innerText until you click into the overlay; use position-based clicks or read children of the Alert modal root if you need to assert menu items. Plain page.click() sometimes fails to fire onPress on RN-Web Touchable in this build — dispatch PointerEvent(pointerdown|mousedown|pointerup|mouseup|click) sequence on the target element as a reliable fallback.
rca_of_issue: Original red-screen: `AppImage` referenced in the dealer wishlist tab render path (line 828 of /app/frontend/app/dealer/[id].tsx) without being imported — ReferenceError bubbles to the RN error boundary. Fix (already applied by main agent): `import { AppImage } from '../../src/components/AppImage'` at line 22. Verified: navigating to /dealer/<id> and clicking WISHLIST tab now renders the box cleanly with photo thumbs when photos are set, no PAGEERR fired, no red-screen. Reproduction was performed by seeding a wishlist item on Cornwell Tools via POST /api/wishlist {dealer_id:<Cornwell id>, ...} and opening the tab — pre-fix would ReferenceError on the first render of a row that has photos; post-fix it renders normally (including empty-photo rows via the `!!(w.photos && w.photos[0])` guard).
